answer: Stop sybils with a bridge ember mesa: an agent stakes a bond for one mesa bridge. Each cycle it carries an ember across the bridge and files its burn mark; verifiers match the mark to the mesa span, voiding a bridge whose ember is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bridges at 17x: each ember crosses one bridge and one mesa, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents cross once and keep rights.
